title: PACE: Policy-Attested Contract Execution for Safe AI Agents in Decentralized Finance
abstract: arXiv:2608.17220v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents are emerging as interfaces for decentralized finance (DeFi) actions such as swaps, lending operations, and yield management. Because these agents rely on large language models (LLMs) to plan transactions, they inherit the LLM's susceptibility to prompt injection and lack of mechanisms to bind a verifier's approval to the exact transaction ultimately submitted on-chain. We present PACE (Policy-Attested Contract Execution), a transaction-level authorization framework that interposes between an LLM-based agent and on-chain execution. PACE introduces typed transaction intents, a deterministic policy verifier, and signed Policy Decision Records (PDRs) that cryptographically bind the approved intent, policy, and simulation report to the exact execution bytes, with replay and expiration protection. translated_title: PACE：去中心化金融中安全AI代理的策略认证合约执行
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17220v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自主AI代理正成为去中心化金融（DeFi）操作的接口，如交换、借贷操作和收益管理。由于这些代理依赖大型语言模型（LLM）来规划交易，它们继承了LLM对提示注入的敏感性，并且缺乏将验证者的批准与最终在链上提交的确切交易绑定的机制。我们提出了PACE（策略认证合约执行），一种在基于LLM的代理和链上执行之间插入的交易级授权框架。PACE引入了类型化交易意图、确定性策略验证器以及签名策略决策记录（PDRs），这些记录将批准的意图、策略和模拟报告以密码学方式绑定到确切的执行字节，并具有重放和过期保护。一个Solidity智能账户在链上强制执行PDR签名，测量开销为29,826-31,822 gas。我们评估了PACE的性能。
tldr: PACE通过引入类型化交易意图、确定性策略验证器和签名策略决策记录，在LLM代理与链上执行之间提供交易级授权，确保批准与执行字节的密码学绑定，并具备重放和过期保护。
en_tdlr: PACE provides transaction-level authorization between LLM agents and on-chain execution via typed intents, deterministic policy verification, and signed PDRs, cryptographically binding approvals to execution bytes with replay and expiration protection.
